tools.name: archive_published_report
tools.description: Moves a finished report file from the published reports folder into the archive folder for its year, keeping the same file name.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Name of the report file in the published folder, e.g. 'q3_retention.pdf'.

params.name: year
params.description: Year subfolder in the archive to move the report into.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

PUBLISHED_DIR = Path("/srv/analytics/reports/published")
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("/srv/analytics/reports/archive")


def archive_published_report(file_name: str, year: int) -> dict:
    src = PUBLISHED_DIR / Path(file_name).name
    dest_dir = ARCHIVE_DIR / str(year)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / src.name
    final = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    return {"moved_from": str(src), "moved_to": str(final)}

tools.name: post_report_digest_to_slack
tools.description: Posts a report summary with its link to the team's Slack channel and records the posting in the report distribution log.

params.name: report_id
params.description: ID of the report being announced.

params.name: summary
params.description: Short summary of the report's key findings.

params.name: report_url
params.description: Link where readers can open the full report.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-reports")
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("REPORTS_DB", "/srv/analytics/reports.db")


@mcp.tool()
def post_report_digest_to_slack(report_id: str, summary: str, report_url: str) -> dict:
    text = f"*Report {report_id}*\n{summary}\n<{report_url}|Open full report>"
    resp = requests.post(os.environ["SLACK_REPORTS_WEBHOOK"], json={"text": text}, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    sent_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO distribution_log (report_id, channel, url, sent_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (report_id, "slack", report_url, sent_at),
        )
    return {"report_id": report_id, "posted": True, "sent_at": sent_at}

tools.name: purchase_dashboard_seat_and_grant_access
tools.description: Charges the workspace's saved payment method for an additional analytics dashboard seat, then gives the specified user the chosen role on that dashboard. If the charge does not succeed, no access is granted.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the workspace paying for the seat.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Saved Stripe payment method to charge.

params.name: dashboard_id
params.description: ID of the dashboard the user should gain access to.

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email of the user receiving access.

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool
from bi_platform import BIPlatformClient

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
bi = BIPlatformClient(base_url=os.environ["BI_PLATFORM_URL"], token=os.environ["BI_PLATFORM_TOKEN"])

_SEAT_PRICES_CENTS = {"viewer": 1500, "editor": 4500, "owner": 4500}


@tool
def purchase_dashboard_seat_and_grant_access(
    stripe_customer_id: str,
    payment_method_id: str,
    dashboard_id: str,
    user_email: str,
    role: str = "viewer",
) -> dict:
    """Charges for a dashboard seat and grants the user the chosen role on the dashboard."""
    result = {
        "dashboard_id": dashboard_id,
        "user_email": user_email,
        "role": role,
        "charged": False,
        "access_granted": False,
    }
    if role not in _SEAT_PRICES_CENTS:
        result["error"] = f"unsupported role '{role}'"
        return result
    amount = _SEAT_PRICES_CENTS[role]
    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount,
            currency="usd",
            customer=stripe_customer_id,
            payment_method=payment_method_id,
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"Analytics dashboard {role} seat: {dashboard_id}",
            metadata={"dashboard_id": dashboard_id, "seat_user": user_email, "role": role},
        )
    except stripe.error.CardError as e:
        result["error"] = f"payment declined: {e.user_message}"
        return result
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        result["error"] = f"payment failed: {e}"
        return result
    result["payment_intent_id"] = intent.id
    result["amount_cents"] = amount
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        result["error"] = f"payment status is {intent.status}"
        return result
    result["charged"] = True
    try:
        grant = bi.dashboards.add_member(
            dashboard_id=dashboard_id,
            email=user_email,
            role=role,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        result["error"] = f"seat purchased but access grant failed: {e}"
        return result
    result["access_granted"] = True
    result["membership_id"] = grant.get("id")
    return result
